proposals.reason: The accepted SVG is the Ethereum diamond logo (facet paths with opacity 0.45-0.8), not the Etherscan brand mark; it is the logo of the underlying blockchain network, not of the explorer brand this record names. The official current Etherscan circular mark was retrieved from the official brand-assets page and is proposed as a replacement.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official current circular Etherscan mark replaces the misattributed Ethereum network diamond; original vector, no accompanying text, square-cell suitable.

sources.observation: Official brand-assets page lists logo variants with SVG download options, including a circle mark variant; retrieved etherscan-logo-circle.svg (123x123, magnifier-glyph circular badge, #21325B/#979695 tonal ring).

The same official page distinguishes the 'ethereum-original' network brand SVG from the Etherscan logo variants; the accepted repository icon matches the Ethereum network diamond, not any Etherscan-branded asset.
